referrals_description_text_1: Zaproś znajomych, korzystając ze swojego unikalnego linku polecającego poniżej, a oboje otrzymacie nagrodę!
referrals_description_text_2: Otrzymasz 🥕 1 za każdego znajomego, a znajomy otrzyma 🥕 2.

resources_subheading: Przewodniki, dokumenty i aktualności o naszym projekcie: jak działamy, co oferujemy oraz prawne zapisy drobnym drukiem.

pricing_and_product_glamping_text_1: Get cosy in a glamping tent for you, yourself and you again. They are 5m in diameter! If you're sharing it with your partner, you'll get a double mattress with warm blankets and fluffy pillows. In case you want two singles, please let us know.
pricing_and_product_glamping_text_2: There's a lamp to give you light, and a plug for your electronics. Usually the tent will be inside our warehouse, or maybe there'll be availability in the land.
pricing_and_product_glamping_shared_text: Get cosy in a glamping tent for you, and two or three more folks. It's spacious and comfortable, don't worry - they are 5m in diameter. There's a lamp to give you light, and a plug for your electronics. Usually the tent will be inside our warehouse.
Compost toilets and showers are shared.
pricing_and_product_camping_text_1: Bring your own gear, or ask us if we can borrow you some. We recommend a camping mattress, a sleeping bag and a pillow. If it is winter, make sure your gear is warm and waterproof.
pricing_and_product_camping_text_2: Compost toilets and showers are shared.
pricing_and_product_van_parking_text_1: Bring your auto-home to TDF. We have spaces in the land that are flat, with shade and with electricity. Perfect for your home on the road.
pricing_and_product_van_parking_text_3: Compost toilets and showers are shared.

roles_page_description_1: Dołącz do naszej tętniącej życiem społeczności regeneracyjnej, gdzie praca i życie łączą się płynnie. Poszukujemy pasjonatów, którzy chcą przyczynić się do zrównoważonej przyszłości, żyjąc w harmonii z naturą i podobnie myślącymi ludźmi. Nasze role oferują więcej niż tylko zatrudnienie - zapewniają możliwość bycia częścią rosnącego ekosystemu, który ceni współpracę, naukę i zarządzanie środowiskiem.
roles_page_description_2: Niezależnie od tego, czy jesteś doświadczony w ogrodnictwie, budownictwie, gościnności, czy masz inne talenty do podzielenia się, witamy różnorodne perspektywy i umiejętności. W zamian doświadczysz życia w społeczności, nauczysz się praktyk regeneracyjnych i przyczynisz się do znaczących projektów, które mają wpływ.

map_page_intro: Land-based regenerative projects across the world — the ones already running on Closer, and the ones on their way.
ambassadors_page_intro: Ambassadors put regenerative land projects on the map, walk the strongest ones into Closer, and earn a share of everything those villages go on to make.
ambassadors_rewards_body: Joining makes you an affiliate. Once a village you brought in is live, a configurable share of what it earns comes back to you — for as long as it runs on Closer.
ambassadors_responsibility_1: Introduce projects you actually know, add them to the map, and set up the first conversation when there’s a fit.
ambassadors_responsibility_2: Stay their first point of contact once they’re in — shared chat, bug reports, regular calls, help growing.
ambassadors_responsibility_3: Get them subscribed and request their deployment when they’re ready to go live.
ambassadors_error_system: System not ready. Please refresh and try again.
ambassadors_error_signup: Could not enable Ambassador status. Please try again.
ambassadors_signup_success: Your affiliate status is live. Put your first village on the map, or head to your dashboard to see how earnings are tracked.
ambassadors_faq_rewards_a: Joining grants you affiliate status. You earn a share of the revenue from every village attributed to you — the rates are set by us and visible in your dashboard.
ambassadors_faq_map_q: What is Tier 0 on the map?
ambassadors_faq_map_a: Listing a village on the map is free and commits them to nothing. It makes them discoverable to the whole network, and it’s where every Closer village starts.
ambassadors_faq_deploy_a: There is no setup fee. The village subscribes at €49/month with the first month free, then you or the owner requests deployment. Our team builds it out by hand for now — automation comes later.
ambassadors_profile_hint: Every Ambassador gets a public profile listing the villages they brought in.
villages_page_intro: Every land project on the Closer map — from a first pin to a village running its whole operation on the platform.
villages_empty: The directory is still filling up. Take a look at the map in the meantime.
villages_create_title: Add a village to the map
villages_create_intro: Drop a pin, tell their story, and check the fit. Listing is free and commits the village to nothing — you’ll be recorded as their ambassador.
villages_create_ambassador_required: Adding a village to the map is something Ambassadors do. Joining takes one click, it’s free, and you start earning on every village you bring in.
villages_deploy_pending: Deployment requested. Our team builds these by hand — you’ll hear back shortly.
villages_deploy_modal_error_invalid: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens — starting and ending with a letter or number.

village_launch_intro: Put your village on the map and get it ready to run on Closer. Check the details, drop the pin, and it goes live in the directory right away.
village_launch_prefill_note: We pre-filled this from your application — edit anything before saving.
village_launch_subscription_body: Launching a village runs on an active subscription. Pick a plan and come straight back here — your application answers are saved.
village_launch_existing_body: Each member can launch one village, and yours is already on the map.
villages_assign_ambassador_hint: Ambassadors you assign can set this village's verification status.
villages_action_error: That didn’t go through. Please try again.
deploy_queue_intro: Villages waiting for their Closer app. Approve the build, fulfil it via Procurement, then mark them live.
deploy_queue_empty: No villages are waiting on a deployment right now.
map_embed_intro: Embeddable regenerative map for network curators. Filterable Villages with roles, search, and verification badges — Phase 3 curator integration.
ambassadors_hero_footnote: Free to join · no quota · you keep earning for as long as your villages do
ambassadors_toolkit_body: Add villages to the map, follow them through to launch, and track what they earn you.
ambassadors_step_1_body: Add any land project you believe in — a pin, a story, a few photos of what they’re building. Listing is free and needs nothing from them.
ambassadors_step_2_body: Real land, people living on it, something already running, open to digital tools. The form scores this as you fill it in.
ambassadors_step_3_body: Introduce them, help them subscribe, and request their deployment. From then on you’re their first point of contact — and their revenue is attributed to you.
ambassadors_rewards_headline: You earn on everything they do
ambassadors_commercial_trial: Free, so they can try it for real
ambassadors_commercial_body: Bookings, events and content are all included from day one. After they subscribe, you or the village requests deployment and our team builds it out — usually within a few days.
ambassadors_closing_body: Join in one click, add it to the map in five minutes.

residency_no_accommodation_note: Off-site or your own setup. Meals on volunteering days are still included.

residency_stat_sweat_sub: Contribution record · governance weight and recognition

residency_spend_own_tokens_hint: Prefer to keep your allocation? Stake {symbol} you already hold against the upgrade instead — the room's own token rate applies.

residency_tiers_modal_description: $Presence counts the days you have been on the land, up to {max}. Each step is recognition within the community — priority on a season window, a mentor role — and carries no right to payment or tokens.

residency_tokens_not_priced: {accommodation} is priced in cash only — {amount} for the season. Pick a room with a {symbol} rate to spend tokens instead.

residency_configure_ask_host: A space host can set these in the residency config.
residency_missing_seasons: Seasons — the windows a residency runs in, each with a label, a start month and a length.
residency_missing_presence_tiers: $Presence tiers — the ladder that decides how much of an allocation may be taken as cash.

residency_missing_agreement_version: Agreement version — the stamp that freezes what was signed.
residency_missing_accommodation: Accommodation — no listing is marked available for residents, so there is nothing to offer.
residency_frame_body: This program runs under the Portuguese volunteering framework ({law}). Volunteering is unpaid; the Association covers your stay so participation costs you nothing. Paid team roles are arranged separately under a work or services contract.
residency_participation_hint: Indicative rhythm, arranged with your coordinator
residency_exit_note: You're free to end your season at any time, without penalty. As a courtesy to the community, we ask for {weeks} weeks' notice where possible, so meals, rooms and land work can be planned.
residency_stay_covered_intro: So that volunteering costs you nothing, the Association provides accommodation, meals and utilities for the whole season, free of charge. This is program support under {law}, not payment.
residency_checking_rooms: Checking which rooms are free for these dates…
residency_room_taken_note: {accommodation} is already taken for {days} of the {total} days you selected. Pick another room above, or move your arrival and departure.
residency_tokens_not_earned: {symbol} can be spent on stays and upgrades. The allocation is discretionary and is never calculated from the hours you give.
residency_upgrade_fiat_due: Still owed in euros for the upgrade: {amount}
residency_slip_know_body: You may end your season at any time, giving {weeks} weeks' notice where possible. If you're not covered by mandatory social security, you can enroll in the seguro social voluntário — we'll help with the paperwork. Your activities are described in your Volunteer Program (Annex I) and complement, never replace, the work of the paid team.

residency_missing_notice_weeks: Notice — the courtesy notice asked for before someone ends their season.

community_near_you_share_prompt: Meet people from the community who live near you.
community_near_you_share_body: Share your location to discover members nearby. We only show your city and an approximate distance — never your exact coordinates.
community_near_you_empty: No members nearby yet. Check back as more people share their location.
community_near_you_unavailable: Nearby members are temporarily unavailable. You can still share your location so we can match you later.
community_near_you_location_error: Could not read your location. Check browser permissions and try again.
settings_privacy_nearby_label: Show Near you on the community page
settings_privacy_nearby_help: When off, the Near you section is hidden and you will not appear in other members’ nearby results. Sharing precise location is always opt-in.
event_ticket_claim_subtitle: This event is free — we'll just save you a seat.
input_invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number, including the country code.
event_ticket_questions_title: A few questions from the hosts
event_ticket_questions_required: Please answer the required questions before continuing.
